description: List the tables link_query can read (curated gold paths only) and the join keys that bridge facts → dimensions → Census geography. Call this BEFORE writing a link_query. Two-tier to stay context-cheap: with NO arguments it returns a LEAN index — every table's name, grain, detail levels, default `read_parquet(...)` snippet, and join keys (enough to pick tables and write a single-detail join). To get every column and a snippet per detail level for the few tables you actually need, call again with `tables=["<name>", ...]` (a `name` from the index, e.g. 'education/gosa/attendance' or 'attendance', or a dimension like 'districts'). Paste the `read_parquet(...)` snippets verbatim into your SQL — they are exactly what the sandbox accepts.
name: link_tables
